kind.description: demo: a docs clip, voiced, with the shared sound. showcase: voiced, 3 aspects. launch: cards, voice, music.

docs.description: The docs-site page that embeds the clip (demo only).

voice.description: Kokoro voice for a showcase: a name (af_heart) or { name, speed }. hyperframes tts --list names them.

music.description: A launch only: a licensed track (with <name>.licence.md beside it) under the whole video, at under-voice (default -18dB).

uses.description: A showcase built on a demo: its world and steps; its captioned beats are spoken by say:.

hook.description: The opening card: its title, and the line spoken over it.

say.description: With uses: one spoken line per captioned beat of the demo, in order.

end.description: The closing card: the wordmark, this text, and the line spoken over it.

post.description: The text to post with the video (X takes 280 characters). Written next to the render; never posted by the pipeline.

motion.description: A launch made as motion design: this page beside the script (HTML and GSAP, a HyperFrames composition) is the video. Its beats come from beats:, its footage from the terminal scenes by id. 16:9 only.

id.description: The page times every element with data-beat="<id>" from it.

say.description: Spoken over the beat; the beat lasts this line, a lead and a tail.

min.description: The beat lasts at least this long: 2.5s.

beats.description: With motion: the beats in order, each with its line.

id.description: The shot is <id>.png beside the page; window.STILLS.<id> holds the board's size and the boxes asked for.

board.description: An app page in design/, without .dc.html, and its section (#app when left out): ade/ade, ade/ade#needs-you.

start.description: The state the section's prototype opens at, drawn still (its start property): agent, session, home, push, consent.

size.description: The shot's size in CSS pixels, when it is not the page's own: 390x844 for the phone.

click.description: A button clicked before the shot, by its name: Allow once.

text.description: Text replaced on the board before the shot: { VECTORGP66: workstation }.

hide.description: Parts hidden before the shot, by Playwright selector (CSS, or text=…).

find.description: Boxes the page needs, by name: { rows: .rail-row } gives STILLS.<id>.find.rows = [[x, y, w, h], …] in board pixels.

stills.description: With motion: the ADE, Cloud and phone as shots of their design/ boards, taken at 2x when the video renders.

home.description: A preset in scripts/shared/worlds/ (fresh: every shipped extension installed).

workspace.description: A sample project in scripts/shared/worlds/, copied for each take.

without.description: Shipped extensions left uninstalled, for a demo that installs them.

config.description: TOML added to the sandbox config.toml, e.g. a [permissions] rule the clip shows. Never a provider or a key.

ready.description: Text the TUI shows once the session is built and idle. Default: enter send (the hint under the input).

model.description: The model the take calls for real, provider:model. Default anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5, on the render shell's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (decision 0037).

replies.description: Authored answers, in order, replayed by the fixture provider instead of a real model: no key, no cost, the same every take.

setup.description: Steps run hidden before the clip starts: an open session, a reply already on screen. No captions.

app.description: Steps in a headless browser (Playwright; recast draws the cursor and the clicks): click, fill, type, key, wait, scroll, pause.

card.description: A launch card: hook (its text as a title) or cta (the wordmark over its text).

uses.description: A launch scene that records a demo again: say: one line over it, or one per captioned beat.

url.description: An app scene's page: a path served from landing/ (the site as built), or an http(s) URL.

id.description: With motion: the name the page plays this take by (data-take).

run.description: A shell command, typed and entered. A bare `orrery` waits for the world's ready text.

until.description: For run: the text to wait for instead.

type.description: Text typed at the fixed speed.

key.description: A key, optionally repeated: `Down 2`. A single lowercase letter is typed as that key.

wait.description: Show 0.4 s, then cut to the moment this text is on screen.

reply.description: The agent's turn, live: cut to its start, show this much of it at real speed, then cut to its end (the hint says enter send again).

seconds.description: For vhs: how long its visible part lasts.

click.description: App: click a link, button or tab by its name, else by its visible text.

fill.description: App: type into fields by their label: { Email: a@b.c }.

caption.description: On-screen text from this step on; null clears it.

zoom.description: Terminal: ease in on rows a-b [cols c-d]. App: target eases in on what the step clicks or fills. off eases out.

scroll.description: App: scroll smoothly by this many CSS pixels (negative: up).

mark.description: With motion: a name for this moment of the take; the page starts a video there with data-from.
